cohort: 447 nulliparous women with cervical dilation ≤ 5 cm
finding: The best predictor of dystocia was a combination of maternal height ≤155 cm or the transverse diameter of the Michaelis sacral rhomboid area ≤9.6 cm and Johnson's formula estimated fetal weight ≥3255 g, with an accuracy of 90.5%, sensitivity of 70%, and specificity of 93.7%.
